<!--
FDIC-BRC / JFQA revision, Phase 1.2-1.3 (plan i-am-planning-to-enchanted-codd.md).
§1 Direct price-of-discipline test: implied rates on uninsured (>$250k) vs
   insured (<=$250k) time deposits; DiD on each rate and the within-bank spread.
§2 Event study for the spread.
§3 Total uninsured deposits (all categories, excl. retirement): DiD + ES.
Inputs: panel_smallbank (post-jmcb vintage, via fallback) and
        td_rates_20260806.rds (01c_build_td_rates_20260806.R).
-->

```{r}
rm(list = ls())

library(data.table)
library(fixest)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)

source(here::here("code", "_common.R"))
source(here::here("tracks", "fdic-brc-jfqa-aug2026", "code", "_track_common.R"))

save_figures <- TRUE
save_tables  <- TRUE

panel <- readRDS(latest_track_file("panel_smallbank"))
setDT(panel)
rates <- readRDS(latest_track_file("td_rates"))

dt_w <- panel[abs(qtrs_since) < 12]
dt_w[, post := ifelse(qtrs_since > 0, 1, 0)]
# Merge on Date BEFORE factor conversion (factor-level mismatch would misjoin)
dt_w[, D_DT := as.Date(D_DT)]
rates[, D_DT := as.Date(D_DT)]
dt_w[rates, on = c("ID_RSSD", "D_DT"),
     `:=`(rate_ins_td = i.rate_ins_td, rate_unins_td = i.rate_unins_td,
          rate_spread_td = i.rate_spread_td)]
dt_w[, D_DT := as.factor(D_DT)]

setFixest_fml(
  ..reg_dummy = ~ post * high_cecl_equity,
  ..reg_cont  = ~ post * cecl_equity,
  ..controls  = ~ log_total_assets_l1 + equity_assets_l1,
  ..fe = ~ ID_RSSD + D_DT
)

dict_did <- c(covariate_labels_dict, "(Intercept)" = "Constant",
              "rate_ins_td" = "Ins. TD Rate (\\%)",
              "rate_unins_td" = "Unins. TD Rate (\\%)",
              "rate_spread_td" = "TD Rate Spread (\\%)")
order_did_tbl <- c("Post x CECL Adj", "Post x High CECL")

cat("Merged rate coverage in window:",
    dt_w[, mean(!is.na(rate_spread_td))] * 100, "% of bank-quarters\n")
```

## §1 Rate DiD: uninsured rate, insured rate, spread

```{r}
r1 <- list(
  feols(rate_unins_td  ~ ..reg_cont  + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(rate_unins_td  ~ ..reg_dummy + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(rate_ins_td    ~ ..reg_cont  + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(rate_ins_td    ~ ..reg_dummy + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(rate_spread_td ~ ..reg_cont  + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(rate_spread_td ~ ..reg_dummy + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
)
cat("\n================ §1 TD RATE DiD ================\n")
etable(r1, dict = dict_did, order = order_did_tbl)
export_track_tbl(r1, "tbl_td_rates", dict_did, order_did_tbl)

# Two-way clustered variant for the spread (inference appendix consistency)
cat("\nSpread DiD, two-way clustered:\n")
print(summary(r1[[6]], vcov = ~ID_RSSD + D_DT))
```

## §2 Event study: rate spread

```{r}
m_es <- feols(rate_spread_td ~ i(qtrs_since, high_cecl_equity, ref = -1) +
                ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
p <- make_es_plot(m_es, ylab_str = "Coefficient (annualized %)", title_str = "",
                  vline_x = -1)
print(p)
save_track_fig(p, "fig_es_td_rate_spread", width = 6, height = 3)
```

## §3 Total uninsured deposits (excl. retirement)

```{r}
r3 <- list(
  feols(unins_deps_assets ~ ..reg_cont  + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(unins_deps_assets ~ ..reg_dummy + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(ins_deps_assets   ~ ..reg_cont  + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(ins_deps_assets   ~ ..reg_dummy + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
)
cat("\n================ §3 TOTAL UNINSURED / INSURED DEPOSITS DiD ================\n")
etable(r3, dict = dict_did, order = order_did_tbl)
export_track_tbl(r3, "tbl_total_uninsured", dict_did, order_did_tbl)

m_es3 <- feols(unins_deps_assets ~ i(qtrs_since, high_cecl_equity, ref = -1) +
                 ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
p <- make_es_plot(m_es3, ylab_str = "Coefficient (pp of assets)", title_str = "",
                  vline_x = -1)
print(p)
save_track_fig(p, "fig_es_total_unins", width = 6, height = 3)

cat("\n================ DIAGNOSTICS ================\n")
cat("Window rows:", nrow(dt_w), "| banks:", uniqueN(dt_w$ID_RSSD), "\n")
cat("rate_spread_td non-missing:", dt_w[, sum(!is.na(rate_spread_td))], "\n")
cat("unins_deps_assets non-missing:", dt_w[, sum(!is.na(unins_deps_assets))], "\n")
cat("Sample means: spread", round(dt_w[, mean(rate_spread_td, na.rm = TRUE)], 3),
    "| unins_deps_assets", round(dt_w[, mean(unins_deps_assets, na.rm = TRUE)], 2), "\n")
```
